arithmetic: exact, fractions.Fraction in the power basis of Q(w), w^3-2w^2-w+1 = 0

gates.claim: sigma(w) = (w-1)/w is an order-3 automorphism of Q(w); w1,w2,w3 are its orbit
the whole argument dictionary {w_k, q, r, s} lies in Q(w), exactly
hA is the diagonal five-term instance x = y = w2; its identification IS bloch_key
hB is the five-term instance x = 1-w2, y = q
hC is the five-term instance x = w2, y = s
the six division-free identities a CommRing Lean proof needs, all exactly zero
gates.note: B1 makes hB's denominator 1-xy collapse to q, and C1 makes hC's collapse to w2 -- which is why hB's fifth argument is exactly w2 and hC's fourth is exactly 1-s

verdict.roast_outcome: DISCHARGED. hA, hB, hC are genuine five-term instances. The last three arguments of the relation, which are determined as rational functions of (x,y), match the hypotheses' arguments exactly as algebraic numbers.
verdict.hA: the DIAGONAL instance x = y = w2. Its argument identification w2^2 = 1-q is exactly bloch_key, already sorry-free in FiveTwoCyclotomicBloch.lean.
verdict.hB: x = 1-w2, y = q. The denominator 1-xy collapses to q, so the fifth argument is w2.
verdict.hC: x = w2, y = s. The denominator 1-xy collapses to w2, so the fourth argument is 1-s.
verdict.why_exact_matters: a 1e-40 numerical check confirms the relation holds; it cannot distinguish 'this is five-term at (x,y)' from 'some other identity true at these points'. Exact matching can.
verdict.still_open: the five-term relation itself (Abel). This probe shows the hypotheses are instances of it, not that it holds.
